referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Includes the whole manufacturing process to produce cement mortar (raw material provision, raw material mixing, packing, and storage), transports to plant, and infrastructure. No requirements for administration are included. No additional buildings and land-use have been taken into account as it is assumed that the mixing process takes place in an existing building of the sand/cement industry or on the construction site
referenceFunction.name: Cement mortar, at plant

geography.text: The amount of raw materials is based on the definition of the group of mortar III (cement mortar). The transportation distances are based on an average of four Swiss companies. For the infrastructure RER-modules are used as proxy

technology.text: Assumed average current technology. The raw materials are mixed in a certain ratio, transported to the packing installation and packed.
